The constraints force a unique schedule.

- Ann is immediately after Cara, and Gus, Elif come before Ann, so Cara ≥ 3.
- Cara and Dev are at least 3 apart with Cara before Dev, so Dev ≥ Cara+3. Ann and Dev are at least 3 apart, which pushes Dev to Ann+3 or later.
- Dev is before Ben and Hana, so Ben and Hana both sit after Dev. With Dev ≥ 7, only Cara = 3 fits. Cara = 4 would require Dev = 8 and Hana = 9 = Ben, which is impossible.
- With Cara = 3, Ann = 4, and Elif < Gus < 4 forces Elif = 1, Gus = 2.
- Dev = 7 is forced, which leaves Ben = 8, Hana = 9. Then Finn = 6 (two slots from Ben, with Dev between them), and Ivo = 5.

Checking all 14 constraints against 1 Elif, 2 Gus, 3 Cara, 4 Ann, 5 Ivo, 6 Finn, 7 Dev, 8 Ben, 9 Hana:
- |Elif−Ivo| = 4 ✓
- Cara(3) < Dev(7) ✓
- Dev(7) < Hana(9) ✓
- |Ann−Dev| = 3 ✓
- |Cara−Dev| = 4 ✓
- Ann(4) immediately after Cara(3) ✓
- Ben(8) and Finn(6) have exactly one person between them (Dev) ✓
- Gus(2) < Finn(6) ✓
- Gus(2) < Hana(9) ✓
- Elif(1) < Gus(2) ✓
- Gus(2) < Ann(4) ✓
- Dev(7) < Ben(8) ✓
- Ivo(5) < Ben(8) ✓
- |Ann−Ben| = 4 ✓
